title: MCP client: opt-in stdio client for external MCP servers (SolidCraft)

labels.name: source:agent

labels.name: area:mcp

body:
Add an opt-in MCP 2025-06-18 `stdio` client in `crates/app` so CamCraft can connect to external local MCP servers such as `solidcraft-cli mcp` or `solidcraft-cli mcp --connect <addr>`.

## Scope
- Add a native-only (`#[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]`) stdio MCP client module in `crates/app/src/mcp/` that performs `initialize`, `notifications/initialized`, `tools/list`, and `tools/call` over newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0.
- Enforce bounded line reads, per-call timeouts, cancellation checks, and clean child-process shutdown on drop without panics.
- Extend `crates/app/src/mcp/provider.rs` so external tool schemas convert into Anthropic, OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, and Gemini formats with a mandatory `<server_id>__<tool>` namespace prefix. External tools must never collide with or shadow built-in CamCraft tools.
- Store external server definitions in `ViewPrefs` (`crates/app/src/prefs.rs`, `prefs.json`), never in `.camproj`. Each entry carries `id`, `command`, `args`, `enabled` (default `false`), `trusted_hash`, `allow_cloud_data` (default `false`), and `allow_read_only_auto` (default `false`). Never store secrets in `prefs.json`.
- Use only the public MCP specification (2025-06-18) and SolidCraft's public CLI interface.

Done means: Offline tests with a fake stdio MCP server verify handshake, namespaced `tools/list`, `tools/call`, timeout and child-crash recovery without panics, `prefs.json` round-trip with zero secrets, and `cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` passes.

Part of #3793
